title: `svelte-kit package` crashes with `Cannot read property 'replace' of undefined` when preprocessor set in version `1.0.0-next.173`
body:
### Describe the bug

Running `svelte-kit package` with typescript enabled and `1.0.0-next.173` causes a crash.

Works on version `1.0.0-next.172`.

### Reproduction

* `npm init svelte@next something` TypeScript **Yes**, everything else **No**
* `npm install`
* `npm install -D svelte2tsx typescript`
* create `src/lib/Test.svelte` with `<script></script>`
* add `"package": "svelte-kit package"` as package.json script
* `npm run package`

Repo if needed: https://github.com/SarcevicAntonio/as-ds

### Logs

```shell
> Cannot read property 'replace' of undefined
TypeError: Cannot read property 'replace' of undefined
    at file:///Users/sarcevic/dev/as-ds/node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/dist/chunks/index6.js:15455:16
    at String.replace (<anonymous>)
    at strip_lang_tag (file:///Users/sarcevic/dev/as-ds/node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/dist/chunks/index6.js:15451:21)
    at strip_lang_tags (file:///Users/sarcevic/dev/as-ds/node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/dist/chunks/index6.js:15439:2)
    at make_package (file:///Users/sarcevic/dev/as-ds/node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/dist/chunks/index6.js:15312:7)
    at async file:///Users/sarcevic/dev/as-ds/node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/dist/cli.js:923:4
npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE
npm ERR! errno 1
npm ERR! as-ds@0.0.1 package: `svelte-kit package`
npm ERR! Exit status 1
```


### System Info

```shell
npx: Installierte 1 in 1.46s

  System:
    OS: macOS 11.5.2
    CPU: (8) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8279U CPU @ 2.40GHz
    Memory: 291.90 MB / 16.00 GB
    Shell: 5.8 - /bin/zsh
  Binaries:
    Node: 14.17.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v14.17.0/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.21.1 - ~/.yarn/bin/yarn
    npm: 6.14.13 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v14.17.0/bin/npm
  Browsers:
    Chrome: 94.0.4606.61
    Firefox: 92.0
    Safari: 14.1.2
  npmPackages:
    @sveltejs/kit: next => 1.0.0-next.173 
    svelte: ^3.42.6 => 3.43.0 
```


### Severity

annoyance

### Additional Information

I have no clue and never worked with svelte/kit internals, but after some digging it seems to be related to https://github.com/sveltejs/kit/pull/2486/files.

If a preprocessor is set the `strip_lang_tag` function doesn't check if `attributes` is defined and calls `.replace(...)` on it, i.e. it expects every `script` and `style` tag to contain `lang` or `type` attributes.

Quickfix could be to add a `if (!attributes) return tag;` above `const idx = tag.indexOf(attributes);` in line 209 of `packages/kit/src/packaging/index.js`.

Workaround would be to add lang="" to any `script` and `style` tags which have not set anything.
